t: The Milwaukee Magnetic (Gen 2) Tape Measure is an essential tool for accurate measurements on any job site. It features a durable nylon-coated high carbon steel blade with both metric and imperial scales, including double-sided printing with vertical and horizontal scales and an architectural scale for reading scaled drawings such as blueprints, making it suitable for electricians, carpenters, and general builders. The tape measure offers a 4.5m standout reach for precise long-distance measurements, while the 30mm wide blade provides increased stability. A finger-stop feature allows for quick, controlled retraction, and the double-sided anti-tear coating on the first 15cm improves blade durability, further supported by a long-lasting full nylon extrusion coating. The impact-resistant plastic case is designed to withstand tough conditions, while the strong magnetic anchor hook provides maximum holding power and secure attachment. This reliable measuring tape is built for professional use, delivering consistent performance and durability.
